Z čeho se počítá zátěž · rozklikni detai: What the load is computed from · tap for details
Z maximálního a klidového tepu se počítá: The load of every run and the minutes in Z4+ come from the maximum and resting heart rate, Intensity and Speed from critical speed. When the maximum is off, the load of hard sessions is overstated (a maximum too low) or hidden (too high).
z nejrychlejších úseků za 90 dní: from the fastest sections of the last 90 days
Zátěž dne je součet zátěže všech aktivit: The load of a day is the sum of all its activities (runs from heart rate, strength from effort, the same as in Total load). Fitness is its weighted average with a 42-day time constant, Fatigue with 7 days: yesterday weighs most and older days gradually less. Freshness is (Fitness − Fatigue) ÷ Fitness. The limits of a “balanced” load (−10 to +5 %) are an app convention, not a research finding. The fitness–fatigue model describes groups well but individuals more roughly, so it does not decide today's training.
zóny a tvrdé minuty se počítají od prahu: zones and hard minutes are counted from the threshold
